_comment: THE single source of truth for every user-facing string the published pages render FROM CODE, and for the locale records that go with them. Reader: scripts/i18n.py (the only one). Guard: scripts/tests/test_i18n.py, which fails the build if a renderer grows a Vietnamese literal, if a key is missing a locale, or if two locales of one message disagree about their {placeholders}. Twin of instruments.json and methods.json. NOT in here: (a) labels the registries already own -- dimension labels, `reads` glosses, pane labels and preset names live in methods.json, instrument display metadata in instruments.json, both now as {en, vi} objects; (b) machine values -- the narrative verdict enum, the structure words htf_context.py matches on, methodology names, acronyms, symbols, timeframes, preset ids and file paths are never translated, only given display labels here where one is needed; (c) prose the MODEL writes -- layer 2 (data/live/prelim/*.model.html) and layer 3 (data/live/narrative/*.json) are authored in Vietnamese at analysis time and inserted verbatim; phase 2 makes those bilingual at the source (docs/specs/2026-09-17-artifact-i18n-design.md).
_locales_note: `tz` is PRESENTATION ONLY -- it shifts what a timestamp reads as, never a stored time, a candle time, a decision time, or the IANA-zone killzone/session computation (chart.js SESSIONS, journal.py). VNT is UTC+7 with no DST, so a fixed offset is correct for it; were a DST zone ever added it would need a real zone id here instead. `number_locale` is deliberately en-US for BOTH languages: swapping decimal and thousands separators between languages on a page full of prices is a misreading risk with no upside, and keeping them identical is what lets test_i18n.py assert that every number is byte-identical across locales.

ui.vi_source.page.en: The analysis text on this page is written in Vietnamese by the analysis model and is shown as written — it is not translated, because translating an analysis would change it. Vietnamese passages are marked, and the times inside them are UTC.

_layer1_purity_note.en: These messages are rendered INSIDE per-method blocks that scripts/method_purity.py checks, in every locale, and an impure translation aborts the build (exit 2). Two rules shaped the English wording. A Wyckoff block may not use ICT or liquidity vocabulary: `l1.level.*` says 'closed beyond', never 'swept', because level lines render into the Wyckoff block too. An ICT block may not use Wyckoff vocabulary or name volume at all: `l1.ict.range_pos` says 'dealing range' (the ICT term), never 'trading range' (Wyckoff's), and `l1.ict.*` says 'expect continuation higher', never 'markup'. Do not 'improve' these into the more idiomatic word without re-running the build.
_layer1_purity_note.vi: Các thông điệp này nằm trong khối theo phương pháp mà scripts/method_purity.py kiểm tra ở mọi ngôn ngữ; bản dịch sai từ vựng sẽ chặn build (exit 2).

_bias_purity_note.en: The bias basis is rendered on the page AND fed to the model brief, and each half must stay inside its own method's vocabulary (scripts/method_purity.py). Two English words were deliberately avoided: `bias.ict.draw_through` says 'expect continuation higher', never 'markup' (a Wyckoff term, and forbidden in an ICT block); `bias.wy.*` says 'higher timeframe', never 'dealing range' or any liquidity word. scripts/tests/test_i18n.py checks both locales of every bias.ict.* against the ICT rule and every bias.wy.* against the Wyckoff rule.
_bias_purity_note.vi: Phần cơ sở của bias hiển thị trên trang VÀ được đưa vào brief cho mô hình; mỗi nửa phải giữ đúng từ vựng của phương pháp mình.

_gloss_purity_note.en: Each lane's definitions must use only that lane's vocabulary, checked in both locales by scripts/tests/test_i18n.py. The Wyckoff entries say 'penetration', never 'sweep' -- the Vietnamese says 'cú xuyên', not 'quét', for the same reason -- and the ICT entries say 'dealing range', never 'trading range', and never name volume at all.
_gloss_purity_note.vi: Định nghĩa của mỗi lane chỉ được dùng từ vựng của lane đó; kiểm tra ở cả hai ngôn ngữ.

gloss.wyckoff.phase_a_events.d.en: Preliminary Support, Selling Climax, Automatic Rally, Secondary Test — the four Phase A events of an accumulation; the TR is built from the AR high and the SC/ST low (knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md §2.7).
gloss.wyckoff.phase_a_events.d.vi: Preliminary Support, Selling Climax (Cao trào bán), Automatic Rally, Secondary Test — bốn sự kiện Pha A của tích lũy; TR dựng từ đỉnh AR và đáy SC/ST (knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md §2.7).

gloss.wyckoff.spring.d.en: Phase C: a penetration below the TR that closes back inside; type 1/2/3 by volume (knowledge/wyckoff/modern-tools.md §2.6); the Test is the revisit on lower volume.
gloss.wyckoff.spring.d.vi: Pha C: cú xuyên xuống dưới TR rồi đóng lại bên trong; loại 1/2/3 theo khối lượng (knowledge/wyckoff/modern-tools.md §2.6); Test là nhịp kiểm tra lại trên khối lượng thấp hơn.

gloss.wyckoff.phase_d_events.d.en: Phase D: Sign of Strength, Last Point of Support, Back-Up (the revisit of the broken area).
gloss.wyckoff.phase_d_events.d.vi: Pha D: Sign of Strength (dấu hiệu sức mạnh), Last Point of Support (điểm hỗ trợ cuối), Back-Up (kiểm tra lại vùng phá vỡ).

gloss.wyckoff.distribution_events.t.en: PSY · BC · UT · UTAD · SOW · LPSY
gloss.wyckoff.distribution_events.t.vi: PSY · BC · UT · UTAD · SOW · LPSY

gloss.wyckoff.distribution_events.d.en: The matching distribution events; UT/UTAD belong to distribution only, UA to accumulation only (WA p8, knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md §1.3).
gloss.wyckoff.distribution_events.d.vi: Các sự kiện phân phối tương ứng; UT/UTAD chỉ dùng trong phân phối, UA chỉ trong tích lũy (WA p8, knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md §1.3).

gloss.wyckoff.chobev.d.en: Three CHoBEV make one CHoCH — the mandatory gate before any phase label is assigned (knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md §2.6).
gloss.wyckoff.chobev.d.vi: Ba CHoBEV tạo một CHoCH — cổng bắt buộc trước khi gán nhãn pha (knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md §2.6).

gloss.wyckoff.effort_result.d.en: Compare candle range against volume: in harmony = continuation, diverging = exhaustion or absorption (knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md §2.2, §4.1).
gloss.wyckoff.effort_result.d.vi: So biên độ nến với khối lượng: hài hoà = tiếp diễn, phân kỳ = cạn kiệt/hấp thụ (knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md §2.2, §4.1).

gloss.wyckoff.phases.d.en: Stop the trend → build the cause → test → sign → effect; a phase label always travels with its mislabelling test (knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md §2.11).
gloss.wyckoff.phases.d.vi: Dừng xu hướng → xây nguyên nhân → kiểm tra → dấu hiệu → hiệu ứng; nhãn pha luôn kèm đối nhãn (knowledge/wyckoff/advance.md §2.11).

gloss.ict.liquidity.d.en: Buy-side / sell-side liquidity at equal highs and lows; external versus internal range liquidity (knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.6–2.7, knowledge/ict/core-b.md §2.13).
gloss.ict.liquidity.d.vi: Buy-side / sell-side liquidity tại đỉnh/đáy bằng nhau; external vs internal range liquidity (knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.6–2.7, knowledge/ict/core-b.md §2.13).

gloss.ict.sweep_mss.d.en: A liquidity sweep runs through a level and closes back; a Market Structure Shift is a body close past the opposing swing after displacement (knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.14, §2.17).
gloss.ict.sweep_mss.d.vi: Quét thanh khoản = xuyên qua rồi đóng lại; Market Structure Shift = nến đóng cửa phá swing ngược chiều sau displacement (knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.14, §2.17).

gloss.ict.displacement_fvg.d.en: A strong push leaves a Fair Value Gap (candle 1 and candle 3 do not overlap); the FVG is drawn until it is mitigated (knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.16, §2.21).
gloss.ict.displacement_fvg.d.vi: Nến đẩy mạnh để lại Fair Value Gap (nến 1 và nến 3 không chồng nhau); FVG được vẽ tới khi lấp (knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.16, §2.21).

gloss.ict.order_block.d.en: The last opposing candle before displacement; the OB line is that candle's open, mean threshold = 0.5 of the body; tight stop = body low (close), wide stop = the low of the sweep (knowledge/ict/core-b.md §2.5, re-checked against the PDF 2026-09-12).
gloss.ict.order_block.d.vi: Nến ngược chiều cuối cùng trước displacement; đường OB = giá mở của nến đó, mean threshold = 0.5 thân; stop chặt = đáy thân (close), stop rộng = đáy cú quét (knowledge/ict/core-b.md §2.5, xác minh lại PDF 2026-09-12).

gloss.ict.cisd.d.en: Change in State of Delivery: a close through the open of the first candle in the last opposing-colour run into the level; earlier than the MSS (knowledge/ict/core-b.md §2.3, knowledge/ict/models.md §2.3).
gloss.ict.cisd.d.vi: Change in State of Delivery: nến đóng qua giá mở của nến đầu tiên trong chuỗi nến ngược màu cuối cùng chạy vào mức; sớm hơn MSS (knowledge/ict/core-b.md §2.3, knowledge/ict/models.md §2.3).

gloss.ict.dealing_range.d.en: The range is the nearest unswept BSL↔SSL pair (where the liquidity sits); EQ = 50%; buy in discount, sell in premium; with no pair, the window edges are used and said so (knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.18–2.19).
gloss.ict.dealing_range.d.vi: Range = cặp BSL↔SSL chưa quét gần nhất (nơi thanh khoản đang nằm); EQ = 50%; mua ở discount, bán ở premium; khi không có cặp thì dùng biên cửa sổ và ghi rõ (knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.18–2.19).

gloss.ict.prev_levels.d.en: Previous day's, previous week's and session highs and lows are liquidity levels; a wick through that closes back = failure to displace (a reversal frame), a body close through = the level was the draw (knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.8–2.9, §2.12, §2.14). The day boundary (00Z) and the session windows (session-model.md) are project assumptions.
gloss.ict.prev_levels.d.vi: Đỉnh/đáy ngày, tuần trước và phiên là mức thanh khoản; râu xuyên rồi đóng lại = failure to displace (đóng khung đảo chiều), thân đóng qua = mức là draw (knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.8–2.9, §2.12, §2.14). Ranh giới ngày (00Z) và phiên (session-model.md) là giả định dự án.

gloss.ict.ote_std.d.en: OTE: fib 1 at the leg's origin, 0 at its extreme, entry band 0.62–0.79, emphasis 0.705 (knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.20). Std: 1 at the sweep's extreme, 0 at the prior highest high / lowest low; −2/−2.5 the exit band, −4 the maximum extension (knowledge/ict/core-b.md §2.12, knowledge/ict/models.md §2.1.5).
gloss.ict.ote_std.d.vi: OTE: fib 1 tại gốc nhịp, 0 tại đỉnh/đáy nhịp, vùng vào 0.62–0.79, nhấn 0.705 (knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.20). Std: 1 tại cực trị cú quét, 0 tại đỉnh/đáy tạo highest high/lowest low trước đó; −2/−2.5 vùng chốt, −4 mở rộng tối đa (knowledge/ict/core-b.md §2.12, knowledge/ict/models.md §2.1.5).

gloss.ict.killzone.d.en: Two sets of EST hours in the deck, with no rule for crypto or CFD (knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.1, §6). The page draws them per docs/architecture/session-model.md: LDN 08–11 Europe/London, NY AM 08:30–11, NY PM 13:30–16 America/New_York, converted to UTC per date; weighting by market; not drawn at weekends — project parameters.
gloss.ict.killzone.d.vi: Hai bộ giờ EST trong deck, không có luật cho crypto/CFD (knowledge/ict/core-a.md §2.1, §6). Trang vẽ theo docs/architecture/session-model.md: LDN 08–11 Europe/London, NY AM 08:30–11, NY PM 13:30–16 America/New_York, đổi UTC theo ngày; trọng số theo thị trường; không vẽ cuối tuần — tham số dự án.

gloss.footprint.poc_imbalance.d.en: The largest-volume level inside the candle; a diagonal bid/ask difference at or above the tool's ratio (knowledge/wyckoff/modern-tools.md §3.2).
gloss.footprint.poc_imbalance.d.vi: Mức khối lượng lớn nhất trong nến; chênh lệch chéo bid/ask ≥ tỉ lệ theo công cụ (knowledge/wyckoff/modern-tools.md §3.2).

gloss.footprint.absorption_seq.t.vi: Hấp thụ → Cạn kiệt → Phát triển

gloss.footprint.absorption_seq.d.en: The reading sequence at the Spring/Upthrust anchor candle (knowledge/wyckoff/modern-tools.md §5 step 5).
gloss.footprint.absorption_seq.d.vi: Chuỗi đọc tại nến neo Spring/Upthrust (knowledge/wyckoff/modern-tools.md §5 bước 5).

gloss.footprint.delta.d.en: Strong / moderate / weak / hidden divergence at the Spring or UTAD location (knowledge/wyckoff/modern-tools.md §3.3).
gloss.footprint.delta.d.vi: Phân kỳ mạnh/vừa/yếu/ẩn tại vị trí Spring hoặc UTAD (knowledge/wyckoff/modern-tools.md §3.3).

gloss.heatmap.liq_cluster.d.en: A price area where liquidation orders concentrate — a target, or a place to be run through (master spec).
gloss.heatmap.liq_cluster.d.vi: Vùng giá tập trung lệnh thanh lý — mục tiêu hoặc điểm quét (master spec).

gloss.heatmap.ob_wall.d.en: Concentrated resting liquidity; where it coincides with a liquidation cluster it counts as one observation, not two.
gloss.heatmap.ob_wall.d.vi: Thanh khoản nằm chờ tập trung; trùng cụm thanh lý thì tính là một quan sát.

The stored words stay Vietnamese: htf_context.py LONG_STRUCT/SHORT_STRUCT match on them to decide bias direction, so translating them in storage would change a decision, not a label. A word with no entry here is shown verbatim and marked as Vietnamese.
_structure_note.vi: Nhãn hiển thị cho các từ cấu trúc Wyckoff. Giá trị lưu trữ giữ nguyên tiếng Việt vì htf_context.py so khớp trên chúng.

legend.plans.vi: kế hoạch lệnh từ trades/ (hộp đỏ = rủi ro, xanh = lời)

legend.killzone.vi: killzone LDN / NY AM / NY PM theo session-model (½ = trọng số giảm)

_journal_note.en: The trade-journal page (scripts/journal_render.py). Its per-trade REVIEW fields are human/Claude prose and are shown verbatim through i18n.vi_source, the same treatment the chart pages give model prose.
_journal_note.vi: Trang nhật ký giao dịch. Phần review từng lệnh là văn bản người viết, giữ nguyên văn.

journal.eyebrow.en: journal · figures computed by code · reviews written by a human or Claude

journal.why.automation_off.vi: automation đang TẮT{stopped} — pilot không tick nên không thể có lệnh mới

journal.why.no_records.vi: chưa có bản ghi nào trong log

journal.reviews.note.en: After each trade, answer five questions: is the thesis still right · plan versus actual · was any rule broken (followed_plan) · root cause (root_cause) · one concrete change for next time (what_to_change). Repeated mistakes are collected in docs/mistakes/MISTAKE-DB.md; update with scripts/journal.py review <id> --set key=value.
journal.reviews.note.vi: Sau mỗi lệnh, trả lời năm câu: luận điểm còn đúng không · kế hoạch so với thực tế · có phá luật nào không (followed_plan) · nguyên nhân gốc (root_cause) · một thay đổi cụ thể cho lần sau (what_to_change). Sai lầm lặp lại được gom trong docs/mistakes/MISTAKE-DB.md; cập nhật bằng scripts/journal.py review <id> --set key=value.

journal.footer.detail.en: trades/index.jsonl (derived from trades/*.md) · pilot log · automation-config.json · generated {gen} by scripts/journal.py render · synced automatically after every pilot tick (scripts/pilot-loop.sh) and by /journal, /status, /review.

_panel_note.en: The method control panel (scripts/method-panel.py). It is an INTERACTIVE artifact with the db capability, and the language choice is per-viewer presentation -- it goes to localStorage, never to a db row, because those rows drive real automation (docs/security/2026-09-12-method-panel.md PANEL-01). The disclosure below is PANEL-02 and must stay visible in every language.
_panel_note.vi: Trang công tắc phương pháp. Lựa chọn ngôn ngữ chỉ lưu cục bộ, không bao giờ ghi vào db điều khiển.

panel.disclosure.en: Tapping here changes the trading configuration that is currently running. This page CANNOT record who tapped — the audit trail only records the actor "artifact-panel".
